LanguageData.MPA_Setting_QualityStepDesc: How much each quality tier above or below Normal raises or lowers a modification's effects. At 15%, a Legendary modification is 160% as effective as a Normal one and an Awful one is 70% as effective.
LanguageData.MPA_Setting_NpcChance: Chance for enemy and visitor power armor to carry modifications: {0}
LanguageData.MPA_Setting_NpcChanceDesc: When a non-player pawn is generated wearing modular power armor, this is the chance each armor piece comes with one to three random modifications. Their quality depends on the pawn's kind, like the rest of their gear.
LanguageData.MPA_Setting_RenderGraphicsDesc: Show the visuals of installed modifications on the pawns wearing them. Turn this off if the overlays clash with another mod's armor textures.
LanguageData.MPA_Reason_RemoveWouldOverload: the other modifications wouldn't fit without {0}
LanguageData.MPA_Reason_RemoveWouldOverloadOther: {1} needs the computational load {0} gives it
LanguageData.MPA_Reason_ModulusUnusable: {0} has no power or is broken down
LanguageData.MPA_InspectOverloaded: Overloaded: more computational load is in use than this piece has, so its modifications are offline. Free some load, or put back on the armor piece that was providing the extra load.
LanguageData.MPA_InspectSpent: Spent: this second heart has already refused a death. Remove it and install a new one.
LanguageData.MPA_Stat_LoadInUseDesc: How much of this piece's computational load its installed modifications use, out of the total available. If more is in use than available (when a piece that provided extra load comes off), the modifications go offline.
LanguageData.MPA_Stat_InstalledDesc: Modifications installed in this armor piece. The percentage shows how strongly each one applies its effects, after quality and bionic synchronization.
LanguageData.MPA_Stat_FitsDesc: Which power armor pieces this modification can be installed in.
LanguageData.MPA_Stat_ExcludesDesc: Modifications that can't be installed in the same armor piece as this one.
LanguageData.MPA_Stat_QualityEffectDesc: This modification is {0} quality. Each quality tier above or below Normal changes its effects by {1}. The effects listed here already include it.\n\nFactors scale their distance from 100%: a x115% bonus becomes x117% at 115% strength. Drawbacks work the other way round: better quality makes them smaller.
LanguageData.MPA_Stat_NoQualityDesc: This modification has no quality; its effects are always the same.
LanguageData.MPA_Stat_PenaltyDesc: This is a drawback of the modification: better quality makes it smaller.
LanguageData.MPA_Stat_PainDesc: Multiplies the pain the wearer feels from injuries.
LanguageData.MPA_Stat_BleedingDesc: Multiplies how fast the wearer bleeds.
LanguageData.MPA_Stat_CoveredPainDesc: Multiplies the pain from injuries and conditions on the body parts the armor piece covers, and the organs inside them.
LanguageData.MPA_Stat_CoveredHealingDesc: How much injury damage is healed each day on the body parts the armor piece covers and the organs inside them, on top of natural healing. Scars and other permanent injuries heal too.
LanguageData.MPA_Stat_CoveredTendingDesc: Every so often, tends one random bleeding wound on the body parts the armor piece covers.
LanguageData.MPA_Stat_SeeThroughDesc: The wearer sees through blindness, darkness, fog and smoke. Their sight never drops below what the sensor gives a sighted wearer, even without working eyes; they don't work slower or get upset in the dark; and weather, smoke and darkness don't spoil their aim.
LanguageData.MPA_Stat_NoStaggerDesc: Hits don't stagger the wearer, so they keep moving at full speed under fire.
LanguageData.MPA_Stat_RefuseDeathDesc: If the wearer's head is destroyed, they don't die. They are kept alive at {0} consciousness, all of their wounds are tended and they get a surge of speed, but unless the head is restored somehow they die {1} later. Bleeding out and other fatal wounds still kill. Works once; the spent module has to be replaced.
LanguageData.MPA_Stat_LongjumpRangeDesc: How far the wearer can leap, in cells. Leaps go over walls and through roofs, but not through mountains, and can't land on an occupied spot.
LanguageData.MPA_Stat_LongjumpCooldownDesc: How long the hydraulics take to recharge after a leap.
LanguageData.MPA_Stat_LoadBonusDesc: Extra computational load for the armor piece this is installed in. Bionic synchronization doesn't affect it.
LanguageData.MPA_Stat_WornLoadBonus: Computational load for other worn pieces
LanguageData.MPA_Stat_WornLoadBonusDesc: Extra computational load for every other piece of modular armor worn together with the piece this is installed in. If this piece comes off, armor that needed the extra load goes offline until it is back on.
LanguageData.MPA_Stat_BionicSyncDesc: Every other modification on the same armor piece gets this much stronger for each implant or replacement part in the wearer. Only parts of {0} tech level or higher count.
LanguageData.MPA_LongjumpDesc: Leap to a spot up to {0} cells away, over walls and through roofs. Can't go through mountains or land on an occupied spot. Recharges in {1}.
LanguageData.MPA_DeathRefusedRecovered: {0}'s head has been restored, and their second heart has let go.
LanguageData.MPA_DeathRefusedTip: Dies in {0} unless the head is restored.
LanguageData.MPA_Effect_Sustained: {0}'s death has been refused: only the second heart is keeping them alive.
LanguageData.MPA_Effect_Overloaded: {0} is overloaded: its modifications are offline.
LanguageData.MPA_Effect_HeartReady: {0}: will refuse death once if the head is destroyed.
LanguageData.MPA_Effect_HeartSpent: {0}: spent. Remove it and install a new one.
LanguageData.MPA_Effect_SeeThrough: {0}: sees through blindness, darkness, fog and smoke.
LanguageData.MPA_Effect_Regenerators: {0} ({1}): pain x{2} on covered body parts, heals {3} injury damage per day there, and tends a bleeding wound every {4} at {5} quality.
LanguageData.MPA_Effect_WornLoad: {0}: +{1} computational load for the other armor worn with it.
LanguageData.MPA_Effect_Longjump: {0}: leaps up to {1} cells, recharges in {2} ({3}).
LanguageData.MPA_ModulusSubtitle: {0} does the work here, wearing the armor. Modifications have to be somewhere on the map {0} can reach.
